description: Reruns of every thesis CV run with a fold that early stopping ended on its selection baseline (selected epoch = epoch -1 or the first epoch after the selection restart, stopped before the epoch cap); found by Thesis/review/patience_recovery_2026-10-19/finde_faelle.py. Each variant is the run's original resolved ablation variant (variant name: <original config>__<original variant>) plus the normal patience (20, Semi-iNat 10) and patience_mode after_recovery with a 100-epoch cap: patience may only end a fold once validation has regained the baseline value, or 100 epochs past the baseline epoch.
name: patience_recovery_rerun_2026-10-19
